title: Kestrel and the Inheritance
author: Odile Marchetti
blurb: Ansel Montrose, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
